nodes.title: Public Knowledge Tree

nodes.title: Agent-UI Protocols: Streaming What the Agent Is Doing

nodes.title: Deployment Pipelines: Self-Hosted CI for Every Repository
nodes.description: CI that runs only on owned hardware, chiefly a self-hosted Mac runner that builds, signs and uploads iOS and Android releases; why GitHub-hosted runners never trigger automatically, and the release rules every app follows.

headings.text: Deployment Pipelines: Self-Hosted CI for Every Repository

nodes.title: Full-Lifecycle Pipelines: From Brief to Store
nodes.description: The estate's end-to-end delivery chain as five automated stages (brief, build and verify, supervision, media, release), each linked to the node that describes it in detail.

nodes.title: Local-First Mobile Systems: The Device Owns the Data
nodes.description: How the estate's mobile apps keep data on the device and use servers only where they must, with the concrete choices in Tackry, Section Launcher, Cruffled, Square Swaps, Weatherie and AudioTales.

headings.text: Local-First Mobile Systems: The Device Owns the Data

nodes.title: Multi-Agent Systems: Running Parallel Agents That Ship
nodes.description: How work is split across parallel coding agents (bounded increments, disjoint file ownership, quarantine, resumption from transcripts, shared context from the brain), and the in-product agent designs (bounded tool loops, MCP tools, specialist agents).

headings.text: Multi-Agent Systems: Running Parallel Agents That Ship

nodes.title: Product Engineering with Agents: Pipelines for Everything
nodes.description: Andrea's working principles: automate every recurring step, give agents a way to check their work, ship to real users, keep data on the device, and let the owner's taste be written down where agents can follow it.

headings.text: Product Engineering with Agents: Pipelines for Everything

nodes.title: AudioTales: Photograph a Picture Book, Hear It Read Aloud
nodes.description: Mobile app that turns photos of a picture book into a narrated audiobook in 139 languages, with an AI storyteller, your own recorded voice, music and offline copies; 1.0 submitted to the App Store and Google Play on 2026-10-13.

headings.text: AudioTales: Photograph a Picture Book, Hear It Read Aloud

headings.text: Rogue Calculator: Math Roguelike on a Dying Calculator

nodes.title: Cruffled: Crossword-Jumble Game and Embeddable Puzzle Applet

nodes.title: Tackry: Offline Notes, Lists and Reminders for Android

headings.text: Two Truths & the Lie: An LLM-Generated Trivia Game

nodes.title: Advection Software: Founding Product Engineer

headings.text: Aplicaciones En Informática Avanzada: Applied Data Systems

headings.text: Alps Fund Services: Mutual Fund Accounting

headings.text: Giesecke+Devrient: Secure Mobility, Telecom Services and Test Automation

headings.text: Intellisense.io: Industrial AI for Mining Operations

nodes.title: Android and Kotlin

nodes.title: Python

nodes.title: Svelte and SvelteKit
